biography.value:
Description

This brilliantly colored ancient dragon has scales, teeth, and claws made of multicolored crystal, and its wings are sheets of flexible glass.

Defense

AC 47, touch 7, flat-footed 45 (+1 dex, +39 natural, -4 size)

hp 478 [638] (29d12+290)

mp 234

Fort +26, Ref +18, Will +23

Defensive Abilities Ray Reflection; DR 15/magic; Immune Paralysis, Sleep; SR 32

Offense

Speed 60 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 200 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +39 (4d6+19 plus 3d6 non-elemental damage/19-20), 2 Claws +38 (2d6+13 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage), Tail Slap +36 (2d8+19 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage), 2 Wings +36 (1d8+6 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage)

Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)

Special Abilities Dragon Force

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (60-ft. Cone, 30d4 non-elemental damage, Reflex DC 34 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Medium Creatures, DC 34, 4d6+18), Heaven's Cataract, Miasma, Mighty Roar, Tail Sweep (Small Creatures, 2d6+18, DC 34)

Spells Known (FC CL 29th, Concentration +37)

At will (DC 18) - Amanuensis, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Moment, Read Magic

1st (DC 19) - Anticipate Peril, Deceleration, Mage Armor, True Strike

2nd (DC 20) - Clockwork Timer, Delay Response, Lesser Celerity, Recall Agony, Slow Magic, Time Shudder

3rd (DC 21) - Alter Fortune, Blink, Dimension Step, Dispel, Haste, Mass Deceleration, Slow

4th (DC 22) - Baleful Blink, Celerity, Dimension Door, Temporal Jolt, Time Shield

5th (DC 23) - Anticipatory Strike, Greater Blink, Second Chance, Temporary Repair

6th (DC 24) - 24 Hours, Age Resistance, Contingency, Greater Dispel, Hastega, Mass Recall Agony, Slowga

7th (DC 25) - Déjà vu, Fate of One, Lesser Time Stop, Reverse, Slow Skin, Stop, Time Spellsurge

8th (DC 26) - Greater Celerity, Moment of Prescience, Recall Death, Withering

9th (DC 27) - Paradox Haze, Stopga, Timeless Body, Time Regression, Time Stop

Statistics

Str 37, Dex 12, Con 31, Int 22, Wis 25, Cha 26

Base Atk +29; CMB +46; CMD 57 (61 vs. trip)

Feats All-Consuming Swing, Cleave, Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Critical (Bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Bite), Wingover

Skills Appraise +38, Bluff +44, Climb +53, Disguise +41, Fly +19, Intimidate +41, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +38, Knowledge (Geography) +38, Perception +39, Sense Motive +39, Stealth +21; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb

Languages Common, Draconic +6 others (DM's choice)

SQ Razor Sharp

description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Tail Sweep (Small Creatures, 2d6+18, DC 34).

A crystal dragon releases the dragon soul within, improving itself or an ally by touch. This ability grants the subject an increase to all physical damage, melee and range, by +1 per three caster levels. It also grants the subject an increase to all magical damage and healing by +1 per three caster levels. This ability lasts for a minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).
